Select compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Source molecule_dictionary parent and molecule_hierarchy children, compound_structures, compound_records, docs, activities, assays, target_dictionary. Join parent to children via molecule_hierarchy on parent_molregno, join children to compound_structures on molregno, join children to compound_records on molregno, join compound_records to activities on record_id, join activities to docs on doc_id, join activities to assays on assay_id, join assays to target_dictionary on tid. Filter parent.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3716726', target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL375', activities.standard_type = 'IC50'. Sort by compound_chembl_id ASC, canonical_smiles ASC, compound_key ASC, pubmed_id_or_doi ASC, assay_description ASC, standard_type ASC, standard_relation ASC, standard_value ASC, standard_units ASC, activity_comment ASC, target_chembl_id ASC, target_name ASC, target_organism ASC.
